== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[The Inner Circle (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-theinnercircle-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-06-The_Inner_Circle.png]]) show the original text.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type, 2012-07-21 capture: https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013); written-out icons (“(Immune to Alter)”, “(Virtual Block 4)”) are drawn as icons; the punctuation follows the Virtual Block 8 list of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013. Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on Conference Room (only at start of game); deploy Sim Aloo here and [Virtual Block 4] There is No Try from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Players may initiate battle here for free. Once per game may deploy Ord Mantell from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May not be canceled (except by opponent) or placed in Used Pile. Immune to Ineffective Manuever.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1281_13</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
